INT. HUDSON YARDS VENUE - NIGHT

Pulsing music and strobing lights flood the space. SARAH ROSE (24, effortlessly beautiful but slightly awkward in her designer dress) steps off the elevator, immediately overwhelmed by the sensory assault. She fidgets with her invitation, scanning the crowd.

A GROUP OF INFLUENCERS stumbles past her, nearly spilling drinks on her shoes. She presses herself against the wall, taking a deep breath.

ROMAN (O.S.)
Well, if it isn't our little bastard princess.

SARAH ROSE
(turning, relieved)
Rom.

ROMAN appears, already a few drinks in, loose but sharp-tongued as ever.

ROMAN
Didn't think you'd show. Thought maybe you were still Team Kenny.

SARAH ROSE
I'm not on any team. I just... wanted to see everyone.

ROMAN
(gesturing broadly)
Well, good luck with that. Shiv's somewhere being Important™, Connor's probably boring someone about his campaign, and our gracious host is...
(spots something across the room)
Oh Jesus, is he actually rapping?

Sarah Rose peers through the crowd to see KENDALL on a makeshift stage, mic in hand. She can't help but smile, remembering him doing the same thing in his kitchen years ago, making Sophie laugh.

ROMAN
Please tell me you're not finding this endearing.

SARAH ROSE
(softly)
Sometimes I miss when we were all just... us. Before everything got so complicated.

ROMAN
(sobering slightly)
Rosie, nothing about this family was ever uncomplicated.

A PARTY COORDINATOR approaches Roman urgently. He shoots Sarah Rose an apologetic look.

ROMAN
Duty calls. Try not to get crushed by Ken's ego while you're here.

He disappears into the crowd, leaving Sarah Rose alone again. She watches Kendall on stage, torn between cringing and wanting to go defend him from the judgmental whispers around her.

Instead, she heads for the bar. It's going to be a long night.

INT. HUDSON YARDS VENUE - NIGHT

The bass THRUMS through the building as SARAH ROSE (24, effortlessly pretty but slightly disheveled) steps out of the elevator. She tugs at her dress -- expensive but clearly not chosen for this kind of party. Her eyes scan the overwhelming scene: strobing lights, writhing bodies, and art installations that seem to mock the very concept of taste.

A PARTY HOST approaches with a tablet.

PARTY HOST
Name?

SARAH ROSE
(awkwardly)
Um, Sarah Rose Roy. I'm Ken's sister.

PARTY HOST
(suddenly deferential)
Of course, Ms. Roy. Would you like me to notify Mr. Roy of your arrival?

SARAH ROSE
No, that's-- I'll find him.

She moves through the crowd, dodging elbows and drinks. Through the sea of people, she spots ROMAN talking intensely with GERRI in a corner. He catches her eye but quickly looks away. She sighs.

SHIV appears nearby, phone pressed to her ear, mouthing "sorry" as she hurries past. Sarah Rose finds herself drifting toward the bar.

SARAH ROSE
(to BARTENDER)
Seltzer with lime, please.

KENDALL (O.S.)
Rosie!

She turns to see Kendall, pupils dilated, energy manic, arms wide open.

SARAH ROSE
(genuine warmth)
Happy birthday, Ken.

KENDALL
(pulling her into a hug)
My baby sister! You made it! Come on, you've gotta see this thing I got. It's fucking wild--

Sarah Rose allows herself to be pulled along, catching glimpses of her other siblings scattered throughout the venue, all in their separate orbits, none quite intersecting.

INT. HUDSON YARDS VENUE - NIGHT

Strobing lights and thumping bass fill the space. SARAH ROSE (24, willowy, wearing a simple black dress that stands out among the more ostentatious party-wear) steps off the elevator, immediately wincing at the sensory assault.

A SERVER approaches with a tray of champagne. Sarah takes one, downs half of it quickly.

SARAH ROSE
(to herself)
Jesus, Ken.

She weaves through the crowd, past the giant replica of herself as a kid that's part of Kendall's "compliment tunnel." She pauses, studying it with a mix of amusement and discomfort.

ROMAN (O.S.)
Well, if it isn't the baby bastard herself.

Sarah turns to find ROMAN, who's clearly already been drinking.

SARAH ROSE
Charming as ever, Romulus.

ROMAN
You shouldn't be here, Rosie. You're crossing enemy lines.

SARAH ROSE
(sighs)
I'm here for Ken's birthday, Rome. That's all.

ROMAN
Right, right. Saint Rosie, floating above all the family drama.

SARAH ROSE
Not floating. Just... choosing not to drown in it.

She spots KENDALL across the room, surrounded by yes-men.

SARAH ROSE
(quietly)
He looks terrible.

ROMAN
Yeah, well, patricide will do that to you.

Sarah gives Roman a sharp look, then walks away, leaving him with his drink. She approaches the massive windows, pressing her forehead against the cool glass, watching the city lights below. A moment of quiet in the chaos.

KENDALL (O.S.)
Rosie! You made it!

She turns, plastering on a smile, as Kendall approaches with his manic birthday energy.

The scene could continue from here with their interaction, highlighting the contrast between Kendall's forced enthusiasm and Sarah's genuine concern for her brother, while maintaining the underlying tension of the family dynamics.

INT. HUDSON YARDS VENUE - NIGHT

The bass THRUMS through the building as SARAH ROSE ROY (24, carefully put-together but clearly uncomfortable) steps out of the elevator. She tugs at her designer dress, scanning the crowd of strangers dancing and drinking.

A PARTY COORDINATOR approaches with an iPad.

PARTY COORDINATOR
Name?

SARAH ROSE
(shouting over music)
Sarah Rose Roy. Or just Rosie. I'm Ken's sister.

The coordinator's demeanor shifts instantly to practiced deference.

PARTY COORDINATOR
Of course, Ms. Roy. Would you like me to let Mr. Roy know you've arrived?

SARAH ROSE
(hesitating)
No, that's... I'll find him.

She moves through the crowd, dodging drunk dancers and influencers taking selfies. Through the sea of bodies, she spots ROMAN talking animatedly with GERRI near the bar. He catches her eye but quickly looks away, pretending not to see her.

Sarah Rose's shoulders slump slightly. She grabs a champagne flute from a passing server and finds a quieter corner, watching the chaos unfold. Her phone BUZZES - a text from RAVA: "You at Ken's party? Let me know if it gets too much. Can send car."

She smiles faintly at the message, then looks up as KENDALL's voice booms over the speakers, announcing his entrance. The crowd surges forward, but Sarah Rose stays put, sipping her champagne and watching her brother's performance with a mixture of concern and secondhand embarrassment.

SARAH ROSE
(under her breath)
Happy birthday, Ken.

A group of guests knocks into her, spilling her drink. She backs further into her corner, feeling increasingly like a spectator at her own family's drama.
